title: Vanilla Custard Pots with Caramelised Sugar
blurb: Smooth baked custards with a crisp sugar topping, made with egg yolks and cream.
steps: Heat your oven to 160°C and lightly grease two small ramekins with the butter.
Warm the cream in a small saucepan over low heat until it just begins to steam, then remove from the heat.
Whisk the egg yolks with the caster sugar and vanilla extract in a bowl until smooth and pale.
Pour the warm cream slowly into the egg mixture, whisking constantly, then strain through a sieve into a jug.
Divide the custard between the prepared ramekins and place them in a roasting tin.
Pour enough hot water into the tin to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins, then bake for 25 to 30 minutes until the custards are just set with a slight wobble in the centre.
Remove from the water bath and let the custards cool completely, then chill in the fridge for at least an hour.
Just before serving, sprinkle the brown sugar evenly over the top of each custard and caramelise with a kitchen blowtorch until the sugar melts and turns golden.
